source_text: Non erunt in scriptura domus Israel — exalegentur de libro viventium. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They will not be in the writing of the house of Israel — they will be blotted from the book of the living. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: Lying prophetesses [[shall not be in the writing of the house of Israel >> Bible:Ezekiel 13:9]]; they are [[blotted from the book of the living >> Bible:Psalm 69:28]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
